headline: Maharashtra GST officials search Sudarshan Chemical offices
summary: Maharashtra GST officials conducted a search at Sudarshan Chemical Industries' offices and manufacturing units under Section 67 of GST law.

headline: Sedemac Mechatronics hits record quarterly ECU sales
summary: Sedemac Mechatronics reported its highest ever quarterly sales of control-intensive ECUs at 1,452,867 units, up 37.5% YoY, while cumulative ISG+EFI ECU sales crossed 1 million units.

headline: Stocks in News: Bajaj HFL, Sudarshan Chem, Redington in focus
summary: Bajaj Housing Finance rallies on strong AUM growth while Sudarshan Chemical jumps despite GST searches. Redington slips after signing a cyber-security distribution deal.

headline: RBL Bank Q2FY27: Deposits up 34%, advances jump 40%
summary: RBL Bank reports provisional Q2FY27 metrics showing total deposits at ₹1,562.8 billion (+34% YoY) and gross advances at ₹1,433.5 billion (+40% YoY). CASA ratio dips to 27.2%.
